name: agent-activity
description: The agent's live activity as rows the desktop renders in the room (events drawer) and the dock (Agent activity panel). Hooks produce the Working and Thinking rows; nothing depends on the agent remembering. Config: AGENT_DISPLAY_NAME names the agent in the first row (env override > this manifest > 'Your agent'). SUTANDO_STOP_INTERRUPT=1 lets a Stop send one Escape to the core's turn on that task and marks it cancelled only once the stop is confirmed; off (default), a cancel marks the task cancelled at once.
